1  ORDER 30.03.2026 Heard Mr. A. R. Agarwala, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the appellant/claimant impugning the Judgment and Award dated 30.01.2026 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 2,
Kamrup (M) in MAC Case No. 2832/2019.

entities.text:
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 2,
Kamrup (M)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant is aggrieved mainly with the quantum of the compensation awarded to him.
I have gone through the grounds stated in the Memo of Appeal.
Call for the records of MAC Case No. 2832/2019 from the concerned Tribunal.
Registry to take necessary steps for requisitioning the aforesaid records.
Let notice be issued, returnable on 22.05.2026.

Let steps be taken for service of notice upon the respondents by speed post as well as by usual process.
Steps within 7 (seven) days from the date of this order.
